frame_acceptance: Accept every mapping frame containing an identified old family52 mask observation; bypass every visibility, seed coverage, bounding box, foreign mask and protected seed quality check. Retain original evidence in frames without an identified old family52 observation.
replace_unit: complete old frame-local-mask observations in family 52
vote_unit: one vote per frame, surface point and persistent ID after union and deduplication
unchanged_other_old_observations: preserve their complete original surface supports, even at shared surface points
pixel_overlap_control: remove only portions of the selected old family masks inside the accepted new mask foreground; add the same new mask support
whole_old_mask_replacement: remove every surface contribution of all selected old family mask observations; add the same new mask support
geometry_and_postprocessing: reuse immutable baseline TSDF and original assignment settings
evaluation: exact unchanged unified v3 debug preset and fixed targets from prior human seed support
